subject: Re: Kickoff: black-box debiasing service — pilot status + small-group risk
body:
Hi both,

Pilot status: both teams are live behind Nikhil's API. Team A (binary risk classifier) is the clean win — randomized_threshold cut their demographic-parity gap from 11.2% to 2.1% with a 0.4-point AUC cost, training-set bias requirement fully satisfied. Team B is the multiclass case, 7 classes, and reduce-to-binary works, but here's the risk I flagged in March showing up in the data: two of their groups have under 400 samples, and on held-out data the bias constraint is violated for exactly those two groups. The papers are explicit that generalization needs sufficient per-group sample size, so this is expected behaviour, not an implementation bug.

Proposal: the service refuses to certify any group below a sample-size floor (I'm fitting the threshold empirically, likely 800–1,000) and reports "insufficient data" instead. Less flattering, more honest.

Csilla
